source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Fairly few specific dietary modifications actually being needed for a client managing heart failure at home","B":"A single, universal diet plan applied in essentially the same way to every heart failure client seen in clinic","C":"Sodium restriction, fluid management, and overall heart-healthy eating patterns, individualized to the client's specific needs","D":"Mainly caloric intake alone, with fairly little attention paid to the other dietary components that matter for heart failure"}}
source_row.rationale: Comprehensive heart failure dietary education typically addresses sodium restriction, fluid management, and overall heart-healthy eating patterns, individualized to the client's specific condition, severity, and any additional comorbidities such as diabetes.
source_row.source_detail: Components of Comprehensive HF Dietary Education
